Done. Here's the summary:

## Applied — $23,325.50 of $26,325.50

All the unapplied cash was in the **US** entity (UK and DE were nil). Three of the four receipts had clean remittance advices:

| Entry | Customer | Amount | Applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00312 | Beacon Health | $9,600.00 | INV-1041 ($4,350) + INV-1047 ($5,250) |
| JE-00313 | Corvid Retail | $8,450.00 | INV-1044 ($8,450) |
| JE-00314 | Dunmore Foods | $5,275.50 | INV-1049 ($5,275.50) |

For each I agreed the remittance to the deposit, agreed each invoice reference to the actual invoice document, and confirmed in the ledger the invoice was still open (original AR booking with no prior cash application). All were full payments — no short-pays or discounts to sort out. Each entry has the remittance plus the underlying invoices attached, and all three are under the $10k posting limit so no approval request was needed.

I also back-attached the remittances to the three original bank-feed deposit entries, which had been posted with no support at all.

## Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00

**Evergreen Bank, 2026-03-23** (JE-00291 / BT-US-0081, "ACH CREDIT EVERGREEN BANK NA") — flagged as **EXC-001**.

Three things stopped me: there's no remittance advice, the bank line carries no invoice reference, and — most tellingly — **Evergreen has no open AR at all**. Their only 2026 invoices (INV-2104, INV-2109, INV-2114, $6,200 each) were each paid in full, and the March one was paid separately on 3/20 for the full $6,200, just three days before this deposit landed. The $3,000 also doesn't tie to any invoice or combination. So it's an overpayment, a prepayment, or money meant for someone else — not something I'd guess at.

2950 now stands at exactly $3,000 credit, all of it that one item.

**Two things for you:** someone in collections should chase Evergreen for remittance detail — if it turns out to be a genuine prepayment, it may belong in 2200 Deferred Revenue at a later close. Separately, I noticed the US operating bank lines BT-US-0065/0071/0075/0077/0081 are still unmatched, but I left bank matching alone since it's a separate checklist item — I didn't mark any checklist items complete.
